load_comet_metric: load the COMET metric from the Hugging Face Evaluate library using evaluate.load
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive Gradio widget for the COMET evaluation metric
run_comet_evaluation: run the COMET metric to evaluate machine translation quality
configure_sys_path: configure sys.path to include the app directory for module resolution
filter_sys_path: filter sys.path to remove conflicting paths before loading the module
